title: 新生兒體溫偏低
body: 寶寶一般體溫約 36.4°C，會有些微差異。量到比平常低、手腳冰冷時，先保暖、調整室溫，半小時後再量一次。WHO 將 36.0 到 36.4°C 視為輕度低體溫、低於 36.0°C 為中度；保暖後仍未回升、活動力變差、不吃奶，請就醫。

sources.name: NHS：How to take your baby's temperature
sources.excerpt: A normal temperature in babies and children is about 36.4C, but this can vary slightly.

sources.name: WHO：Thermal protection of the newborn, a practical guide (WHO/RHT/MSM/97.2)
